items.title: ByePhone- An AI assistant to automate tedious phone calls
items.raw_excerpt:
I have a bit of phone anxiety, and have a ton of dread around making phone calls to restaurants, banks, doctors, and so on and on. I thought: AI could do this with a web form turned into a prompt. Stack started out simple -> using 11labs for voice + claude + twillio, but it actually got rather complex (even though I tried vibe coding most). First off, finding the phone numbers quickly is hard. This is done by scraping the web with some basic duckduckgo search and structure with openai calls. Second, collecting the right information. I’m still struggling a bit with this but the architecture is that: A) user puts in call objective and business name
B) if keywords are detected spin up one of the default form categories
C) if not, get structured json from gpt-4o-mini and turn into react form T

items.title: Finnish Humanizer – 26 patterns for detecting AI-generated Finnish text

items.title: Run 10 AI coding agents in parallel–each opens a PR when done
items.raw_excerpt:
I built Paragent because I kept context-switching between features. The idea: describe what you want in plain English, and an agent branches off, writes the code, and opens a PR. You can run 10 at once — each on its own branch. How it works:
- Connect your repo via GitHub App (minimal permissions: contents + PRs)
- Describe a feature ("Add Stripe checkout to the pricing page")
- Agent plans, writes, runs your verification, opens a PR
- You review on GitHub like any other PR You bring your own API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini). We orchestrate but never store your code or prompts. Free tier: 1 repo, 2 concurrent agents.
Would love feedback from anyone who's tried Cursor/Copilot and wants something that works in parallel.

items.title: OpenBrowser MCP: Give your AI agent a real efficient browser
items.raw_excerpt:
Your AI agent is burning 6x more tokens than it needs to just to browse the web.
We built OpenBrowser MCP to fix that.
Most browser MCPs give the LLM dozens of tools: click, scroll, type, extract, navigate. Each call dumps the entire page accessibility tree into the context window. One Wikipedia page? 124K+ tokens. Every. Single. Call.
OpenBrowser works differently. It exposes one tool. Your agent writes Python code, and OpenBrowser executes it in a persistent runtime with full browser access. The agent controls what comes back. No bloated page dumps. No wasted tokens. Just the data your agent actually asked for.
The result? We benchmarked it against Playwright MCP (Microsoft) and Chrome DevTools MCP (Google) across 6 real-world tasks:
- 3.2x fewer tokens than Playwright MCP
- 6x fewer tok

items.title: Why Moltbook Failed: The Lack of Identity in Autonomous AI Agents
items.raw_excerpt: The collapse of Moltbook (API key leaks, agent impersonation, and human-operated bots) isn't just a security incident. It is a structural failure: the platform lacked any persistent, cryptographically verifiable identity for its AI agents. Without a registry serving as a Source of Truth — providing data on ownership and accountability — any agentic ecosystem descends into chaos. Moltbook is the textbook example. The Hindustan Times reported on this and included my technical commentary, which is based on principles from the book "I Am Your AIB" by Jay J. Springpeace (published January 16, 2026): https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/what-is-moltbook-5-key-facts-about-the-ai-only-social-media-platform-101769833804190.html The book argues for: Cryptographic Identity: Agents must h

It is a structural failure: the platform lacked any persistent, cryptographically verifiable identity for its AI agents. Without a registry serving as a Source of Truth — providing data on ownership and accountability — any agentic ecosystem descends into chaos. Moltbook is the textbook example. excerpt_i18n.zh: Moltbook的崩溃（API密钥泄露、代理冒充和人工操作机器人）不仅是一起安全事件，更是结构性失败：该平台缺乏持久且可加密验证的身份机制。
excerpt_i18n.es: El colapso de Moltbook (filtraciones de claves API, suplantación de agentes y bots operados por humanos) no es solo un incidente de seguridad. Es un fallo estructural: la plataforma carecía de cualquier identidad persistente y criptográficamente verificable.

excerpt_i18n.en:
On February 22, Alibaba Cloud's Coding Plan subscription service added support for four top-tier programming models: Qwen3.5-Plus, Qwen3-Coder-Next, GLM-4.7, and Kimi-K2.5. Users can freely switch between these models without changing subscriptions or configurations. Alibaba Cloud Coding Plan also launched a promotional offer: starting now, new users can enjoy an 80% discount on their first purchase, with 18,000 requests for the first month priced at just 7.9 yuan, and 90,000 requests at 39.9 yuan.  

AI Agents are currently the primary application carriers for large models, with popular tools like Claude Code and OpenClaw emerging in the industry. However, Agents require executing complex tasks and involve multi-round planning and tool calls, leading to an exponential increase in token consumption. Data shows that the computational power consumption of a single Agent is 100 to 1,000 times that of traditional Chatbots. To address this, Alibaba Cloud introduced the Coding Plan subscription service, offering users cost-effective and flexible model options.  

Alibaba Cloud Coding Plan includes two packages: Lite Basic and Pro Advanced. The Lite Basic package offers up to 18,000 requests per month, with the first month priced at just 7.9 yuan for new users. The Pro Advanced package provides 90,000 requests per month, capable of completing thousands of complex tasks, with the first month priced at 39.9 yuan for new users, significantly reducing costs for high-frequency usage.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 22 de febrero, el servicio de suscripción de Coding Plan de Aliyun añadió soporte para cuatro modelos de programación de vanguardia: Qwen3.5-Plus, Qwen3-Coder-Next, GLM-4.7 y Kimi-K2.5. Los usuarios pueden cambiar libremente entre ellos sin necesidad de modificar suscripciones o configuraciones. Además, Coding Plan de Aliyun ha lanzado una promoción: desde hoy, los nuevos usuarios disfrutan de un 80% de descuento en su primera compra, con 18,000 solicitudes por solo 7,9 yuanes el primer mes, y 90,000 solicitudes por solo 39,9 yuanes. AI Agent es actualmente el principal vehículo de aplicación para los grandes modelos, y en la industria ya han surgido ejemplos como Claude C.
